statements.restatement: For the T_45 cost q f2+p f1+j f53+c f12+e f8+d f18+b f7+a f15 with q,p,j,c,e,b,d>0, a>=0, pj<d^2, j<d+d^2/(a+e), and Phi<0: there is no x in X whose restored real point is c + h kappa.
